narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twelve is the biggest size for the short wall, so I choose a twelve feet tile!
<bookmark mark='lay'/>That tile fills the short wall.
<bookmark mark='gap'/>But along the long wall it leaves a gap, because sixteen is not a whole number of twelves.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A tile has to fit both walls, not only one.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows a 12 ft tile; the tile is laid on the plan, fills the short wall once, and leaves a gap along the long wall; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>A tile fits when its side is a common factor of both walls. The largest one needs the fewest tiles.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A room is fourteen feet by thirty five feet. Find the tile sides that fit, and the largest.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the line a tile side must be a common factor of both walls appears; then a new room 14 ft by 35 ft appears with two empty boxes
